Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body: Can a non-Tremere vampire use Alastor to equip Ankara Citadel?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Alastor doesn't say "equip" but "put". In that case, requirements don't apply so à non-Tremere could receive an Ankara Citadel.
